institution: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (UAM) — Escuela Politécnica Superior
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Aprendizaje Profundo para el Tratamiento de Señales de Audio y Vídeo
official_status: máster universitario (official; RUCT, Publicado en B.O.E., TITULACIÓN RENOVADA; Nivel MECES 3, Máster - RD 822/2021; verificación 10/03/2020; BOE 22/01/2021, 26/03/2021, 23/10/2025; Resolución Favorable Renov. Acreditación 21/01/2026)
ects: 60 (RUCT: 48 obligatorios + 0 optativos + 0 prácticas + 12 TFM); UAM page: "1 año (60 ECTS)"
language_of_instruction: Inglés (UAM programme page, campo "Idioma"). Entry requires B2 English certificate or sworn declaration of equivalent level.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 2,701.20 for 60 ECTS (60 x 45.02 EUR/ECTS, "Resto de Másteres Oficiales", matrícula ordinaria) — UAM programme page states "2.736 €" as "precio aproximado del curso en 1ª matrícula", i.e. credits + ~34.80 admin/secretaría fees
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (UAM published tariff "precios-publicos-masteres-oficiales-2025-2026.pdf", under Decreto 43/2022 of the Comunidad de Madrid). The programme page itself states no year. 2026-27 UAM tariff not located.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. UAM programme page: "2.736 €; extracomunitarios no residentes: 5.079 €". Legal basis in the UAM tariff PDF: non-EU students over 18 without resident status pay, for non-habilitante masters, "lo previsto para la tercera y sucesivas matrículas" = 84.07 EUR/ECTS → 60 x 84.07 = EUR 5,044.20 tuition (+ ~34.80 admin = 5,079). The same PDF states a study stay authorisation under RD 557/2011 "no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes", so the candidate cannot escape it by living in Madrid.
complementary_credits_required: Title level (RUCT 4317140): 0 créditos de complementos formativos. Applicant level (UAM programme page): no complementos de formación as such, but admission requires specific prior ECTS — 24 ECTS mathematics, 12 programming, 6 machine learning, 6 signal processing; students without sufficient signal-processing background take a 1-ECTS levelling module ("Fundamentals of Signal Processing") that sits INSIDE the 60 ECTS, not on top.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for 2027-28 as of 2026-08-25. Published UAM calendar is for curso 2026-27: 1er plazo 4 Feb – 8 Apr 2026 (resolution by 27 May 2026); plazo adelantado 4 Jun – 1 Sep 2026; 2º plazo 18 Jun – 1 Sep 2026 (resolution by 8 Sep 2026). Dates NOT shifted forward.
notes: NAME CHANGE CONFIRMED: the title is now registered and marketed as "Máster Universitario en Aprendizaje Profundo para Inteligencia Artificial de Audio y Visual / Master in Deep Learning for Audio and Visual Artificial Intelligence". The input name ("...para el Tratamiento de Señales de Audio y Vídeo", DL4AVS) is the original 2019 name — still the URL slug on uam.es. Same programme, same RUCT code 4317140. RUCT code confirmed by matching the exact current RUCT title to the UAM page title and university; the UAM page does not print a Código RUCT. Tuition arithmetic: 60 x 45.02 = 2,701.20; 60 x 84.07 = 5,044.20; both +34.80 = the 2,736 / 5,079 figures on the UAM page.

official_status: máster universitario (official; RUCT register, estado "Publicado en B.O.E.", Alta Inicial 17/09/2024; Nivel académico Máster - RD 822/2021 (3), Nivel MECES 3; Fecha de verificación 11/03/2024; Acuerdo Consejo de Ministros BOE 27/09/2024; Plan de Estudios BOE 11/10/2024; autorización Comunidad de Madrid 13/08/2024; curso de inicio de impartición 2024/2025)
ects: 60 (RUCT: Nº Créditos Obligatorios 18 + Optativos 30 + Prácticas Externas 0 + TFM 12 = Créditos Totales 60). UAM page: "1 año, 60 ECTS".
language_of_instruction: Español (UAM programme page, campo Idioma). CAUTION: a search-index summary of the EPS faculty page suggested "español e inglés"; that was NOT confirmed on a primary page, so only the uam.es programme-page value is recorded here.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 2,701.20 for 60 ECTS (60 x 45.02 EUR/ECTS, "Resto de Másteres Oficiales", matrícula ordinaria). UAM programme page states EUR 2,736 for 1ª matrícula (credits + ~34.80 admin fees).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (UAM tariff "precios-publicos-masteres-oficiales-2025-2026.pdf", Decreto 43/2022 Comunidad de Madrid). Programme page states no year; 2026-27 UAM tariff not located.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. UAM programme page: EUR 5,079 for non-resident international students vs EUR 2,736. Tariff basis: 84.07 EUR/ECTS (tercera matrícula rate applied to non-EU non-residents for non-habilitante masters) → 60 x 84.07 = EUR 5,044.20 (+~34.80 admin).
complementary_credits_required: Title level (RUCT 3500136): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the detail page carries no "Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos" row at all (this is not the same as 0). application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for 2027-28 as of 2026-08-25. UAM published calendar is for curso 2026-27: 1er plazo 4 Feb – 8 Apr 2026 (resolución hasta 27 May 2026); plazo adelantado 4 Jun – 1 Sep 2026; 2º plazo 18 Jun – 1 Sep 2026 (resolución hasta 8 Sep 2026). Dates NOT shifted forward.
notes: RUCT code 3500136 is printed on the UAM programme page itself AND matches the RUCT detail page exactly — double-confirmed. This is a NEW title (first intake 2024/25) that replaces RUCT 4313538 "MU en Investigación e Innovación en Inteligencia Computacional y Sistemas Interactivos", which is TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR — do not confuse the two. 25 plazas. Research-oriented, gives PhD access. Heavily optional (30 of 60 ECTS optativos).

tuition_total_eur: CONFLICT. (a) Faculty page verbatim: "Precio del master completo en primera matrícula: Aproximadamente 3.200€ para los estudiantes comunitarios y extranjeros no comunitarios residentes." (b) UCM central 2026-27 tariff: 45.02 EUR/crédito 1ª matrícula for ordinary masters → 60 x 45.02 = EUR 2,701.20 + secretaría 6.11 + apertura de expediente 27.54 = EUR 2,734.85. tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 for the UCM central per-credit tariff (ucm.es/informacion/precios-masteres, stated "Curso académico 2026/2027"; rates set by Decreto 43/2022 of the Comunidad de Madrid). The faculty page's ~3.200€/~5.100€ figures state NO year.

UCM states an authorisation to stay for study does not equal residency.

Dates NOT shifted forward. Corroborated by UCM's central "Plazos generales para admisión a másteres universitarios" for curso 2026-2027: PRIMER PLAZO ORDINARIO solicitudes "Del 28 de enero al 20 de febrero" (admitidos a partir del 23 de marzo; matrícula 29 mayo–5 junio); SEGUNDO PLAZO ORDINARIO "Del 27 de abril al 22 de mayo"; PLAZO EXTRAORDINARIO "Del 1 al 4 de septiembre". Years are 2026.
notes: RUCT code 4313376 confirmed by exact title+university match in the RUCT register; the UCM/faculty pages do not print a Código RUCT, so the match is by denominación, not by a printed code — lower confidence than a printed code, though the title string is unique in RUCT. The programme is the renamed successor of the "Máster en Minería de Datos e Inteligencia de Negocios" (faculty page: "una modificación del anterior Máster en Minería de Datos e Inteligencia de Negocios"); the ucm.es slug is still /master-en-mineria-de-datos-e-inteligencia-de-negocios. Curso de implantación 2012-2013. 45 plazas (page states this for curso 2024-25 — the plazas figure on the page is stale). Taught jointly with the Facultades de Informática, Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales, Comercio y Turismo, and the company SAS. UCM public pages are fragmented: ucm.es/estudios/master-cienciadedatos and its -creditos subpage carried none of the requested fields.
